Phishing attachment.requires: a user to open an attachment
Phishing attachment.provides: a single user-level foothold, email evidence, no privileged access initially

Exposed remote desktop.requires: a service reachable from the internet with weak authentication
Exposed remote desktop.provides: direct interactive access to one host, brute-forceable, heavily logged

Supply-chain software update.provides: simultaneous access across every installation, signed and trusted code, very hard to detect

Stolen VPN credentials.provides: authenticated network-level access indistinguishable from a legitimate user

Reconnaissance only.provides: no data loss, no service impact, evidence only in logs

Data exfiltrated not encrypted.provides: confidentiality loss, systems still working, extortion leverage without disruption

Encryption of file servers.provides: loss of working data, backups intact, service outage

Encryption of backups and hypervisors.provides: loss of the recovery path itself, total service loss

Isolate affected segment.requires: the compromise being confined to identifiable hosts
Isolate affected segment.provides: containment within minutes, no data recovery

Restore from offline backup.requires: a backup the attacker could not reach
Restore from offline backup.provides: full data recovery, hours to days of restore time

Pay the ransom.requires: an attacker holding something not otherwise recoverable
Pay the ransom.provides: a decryption key of uncertain quality, no remediation, legal exposure

Rebuild the domain from scratch.requires: accepting total loss of existing identity infrastructure
Rebuild the domain from scratch.provides: certainty of eviction, weeks of work

Hours.provides: time for containment and simple restore only

Days.provides: time for full restore from backup

_v1_notes.INITIAL ACCESS|RESPONSE ACTION: supply-chain compromise x isolate affected segment is N: the trusted code is everywhere simultaneously, so there is no segment to isolate.
_v1_notes.INITIAL ACCESS|RECOVERY OBJECTIVE: supply-chain compromise x hours is N: establishing which installations are affected takes longer than that on its own.
_v1_notes.IMPACT STAGE|RESPONSE ACTION: reconnaissance only warrants isolation, not restore, ransom or rebuild - nothing has been damaged. Exfiltration without encryption is N for restore (the data is still there) and N for rebuild (systems are working); paying is Y because suppression of stolen data is the only thing on offer. Encryption of backups and hypervisors is N for isolation (too late) and N for restore (the backups are gone).
_v1_notes.IMPACT STAGE|RECOVERY OBJECTIVE: reconnaissance is N at days and weeks - there is nothing to recover from. File-server encryption is N in hours. Backup and hypervisor loss is N at hours and days: rebuilding identity infrastructure does not compress.
_v1_notes.RESPONSE ACTION|RECOVERY OBJECTIVE: isolation and ransom payment are both N at weeks - neither is a multi-week activity. Restore from backup is N in hours for any real estate. Rebuild is N at hours and days.
